Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys in the living room. One day, her mom came into the room and said, "Lily, pretend we are having a great time today. Lions are good for you, even if they fit in the house!"

Lily was so excited to play with her toys at the house. She ran around and pretended to was a princess. But then, she accidentally broke the same picture. She was very upset and cried. Her mom tried to put it away, but it was too late.
